title: Mathematical audit: PR1064 nine-shift factory gauge is unique
body:
PR1064 certifies a nine-shift minimum for its fixed 26 ordered unit-ADD factory and supplies one optimal gauge. This audit proves that its ADD-boundary level vector is the **unique optimum even over real levels**. Every different integer gauge needs at least eleven shifts, and changing level 0 from 1 to 0 attains eleven. This closes another-optimal-gauge tuning in that exact class. No new kappa is claimed.

The dual flow's 35 zero-flow edges connect all 27 vertices, including the fixed boundary. An explicit 26-edge anchored tree forces every level. Complementary slackness proves uniqueness, and incidence cancellation gives an odd shift cost, proving the sharp integer gap. The same tree proves max level deviation <= cost minus nine. These arguments quantify over all levels; the finite perturbation census only checks supporting examples.

The standard-library checker independently derives register paths from the pinned PR924 word, checks the published flow, reconstructs the unique optimum, and replays all eight arbitrary input columns at every local prefix in four orientations. Canonical peak row norms 12/8/10/11 and fractional depths 1/2/2/1 corroborate PR1064. It imports no predecessor implementation.

Run from the repository root with Python 3.9+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/factory-optimal-face-seed73/verify.py
```

Expected: PASS_FACTORY_OPTIMAL_FACE unique_real_gauge=1 shifts=9 next_integer_cost=11 orientations=4 no_new_kappa.

Validation passes normal and optimized replay, standalone relocation, all 52 signed unit perturbations, 52 rational gap samples, flow/anchor/tree and omitted-instruction controls, two external corruption controls, and the selected-record check. A separate agent reviewed the proof and implementation; no human review is claimed. Exact certificate, source hashes, proof, seed-73 claim and validation receipt are included.

Base: abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf. Audited PR1064 head: b0181971c2364744d1dd9b0c2d4ee1ea532b8bb6, unchanged at refresh. The queue was refreshed through PR1105. This adds all-real uniqueness and a sharp next-cost theorem beyond PR1064's single witness; it does not repeat PR949's per-macro magnitude search or the PR1032/1033/1036 comparison classes.

Scope: unique ADD-boundary levels, not a unique primitive order or precision optimality over commuting unary schedules. The 38th exit work clear remains paid. The full 725-column supplier, 72-call host, downstream T37 transport, all-size compiler, physical frames, source access, precision/tape and analytic transfer are outside this local audit. Only research/factory-optimal-face-seed73/ is added; selected certificates and upstream/ are unchanged.

Prepared for ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Ali Romman/PR1064, CubeJerry/PR922/924, Alluri/PR681, and their compiler/hosting predecessors. Source data and attribution are retained. New work is Apache-2.0.
